messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — planning a short micro-tutorial + OSS reference app launch for next Wednesday. Need owners for: banner copy, benchmark blurb, webinar RSVP page, inbound lead routing, and iteration plan for messaging. who can take what?

tim: I can run the benchmark narrative and the short benchmark results graphic. will need a 30s script for the webinar demo.

aly: I can own inbound routing + funnel tags. suggest we use `utm_source=devcamp` + `utm_campaign=refapp-launch` and route to the SDR queue with S1 tag.

sarah: I’ll do the banner and hero copy. rough headline idea: "Ship LLM features faster with consistent inference — try the RefApp". want options (concise, playful, technical).

maria: perfect. tim — can you share the benchmark numbers by EOD tomorrow? aim for a single-slide narrative: latency cost vs latency SLOs.

tim: yes. will run the 512-token conversational benchmark on 2 batch sizes and compare Redwood-optimized vs baseline. will paste a short table here when done.

aly: for routing — can we send webinar signups with >company_size:50 straight to AE + add a tag `hot:yes`? otherwise to nurture. also capture `use_case` free-text.

maria: love that. launch-bot: create RFC ticket for the launch checklist and set reminder 48h before.

launch-bot: Created ticket #MK-4821: "Microtutorial + RefApp launch — checklist" assigned to maria, tim, aly, sarah. Reminder scheduled in 48h. :white_check_mark:

sarah: copy iteration plan: publish 3 variants A/B for the hero (technical, outcome, customer quote). run A/B for 48h then pick winner and roll to paid.

maria: thanks all. next step: owners confirm by EOD. if no objections, tim/aly/sarah grab the RFC tasks and we’ll schedule a 20m prep call Mon morning.

aly: confirmed — I’ll update routing docs and add the SDR playbook snippet.

tim: confirmed — benchmarking will be in the ticket.

sarah: confirmed — will share 3 copy options in the ticket.

maria: great — booked 20m prep Mon 09:30 PT. agenda: quick demo script, benchmark slide, RSVP flow, A/B config. see you then :rocket:
